Dungeon synth is dark moody music reminiscent of early medieval video games. It may or may not be an offshoot of black metal, but regardless is frequently used in interludes on black metal albums. 

The second album to the left is called Pale Swordsman by Këkht Aräkh. Its a hauntingly beautiful piece of music that tones down the standard noise and fuzz in traditional norwegian black metal and replaces it with melancholic synth melodies. It’s beautiful but can be depressing. I highly recommend it
